verdict.rationale: BILL's pricing page claims automatic 2-way sync with QuickBooks Enterprise and Oracle NetSuite, with CSV import/export as a manual fallback, and says Spend & Expense transactions are 'categorized.' The sync claim sits on a general pricing page rather than Spend & Expense–specific docs, and nothing shows user-controlled GL account, class, or department mappings. Missing for 10: Xero sync, documented user-controlled GL/class/department mapping, Spend & Expense–specific confirmation that card transactions sync, independent or hands-on corroboration.
